question: If a spell with conspire has targets, can I choose new targets for the copy conspire creates?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you may choose new targets for the copy.
expected.answer: If a spell with conspire has targets, you may choose new targets for the copy.

source.license: Reproduced from the official Wizards of the Coast card-ruling text distributed for use by Magic: The Gathering tools and reference sites; this project already commits and serves this exact rulings corpus in production (see committedDataPath) as its card-ruling retrieval source.

whyHard: Copies made as you cast a spell are not always given a chance to pick new targets, and players assume they keep the original.
